subject: `use base` / `use parent` pushes @ISA at RUN time at its source position -- perl does it at BEGIN time -- so a call that runs BEFORE the package section (or a `use base` inside `BEGIN { package X; ... }`) sees an EMPTY @ISA: SUPER:: and inherited-through-@ISA lookups fail ("Can't locate object method new via package X"); Pod-Simple fake-closers / xhtml20 / xhtml25
